description: tests/common/mod.rs MemoryBackend::import_email(): the duplicate Message-ID check (lines 620-631) acquires and then releases the Mutex lock before the email is actually inserted (line 688+). A second concurrent import_email() call with the same Message-ID can pass the duplicate check after the first has released the lock but before it re-acquires it for the insert. Both imports then succeed and store duplicate emails, violating RFC 8621 §4.8 alreadyExists semantics. Trigger: two concurrent calls to import_email() with blobs sharing the same Message-ID header. Bad behavior: both succeed; neither returns alreadyExists.
title: MemoryBackend import_email duplicate-detection TOCTOU: lock released between check and insert
